title: 第19章 我们是姐妹第20章 混沌气
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 很快秦关来到了山脚下。
一道道阶梯如游龙般，蜿蜒曲折的延伸向山顶。
阶梯下方，插了一个木牌，上面写了四个字：量力而行。
量力而行。
秦关看了眼木牌一脚踏在了山梯上。
当秦关踏上第一步山梯后，一股无形的压力油然而生，身上像是扛了一块大石头。
“原来是重力场域。”
秦关淡淡一笑，这点压力对他来说就是挠痒痒，毕竟以前经常扛着一座小山做深蹲训练。
秦关脚下迈的很快，不一会就消失在了第一个拐弯处。
与此同时其他所有人处在的空间和秦关所在的空间一模一样，只是他们上山的压力远比秦关小的多。
半个时辰后。
一处半山腰上，南乔与南柔一前一后，每上一步都显得很吃力，二人脸色惨白，浑身骨头都被压的生疼。
此时在二人身后不远处，两名身穿蓝色服饰的少年鬼鬼祟祟，他们时不时的会看向身后。
“龙哥，我看还是算了吧。”其中一名身形消瘦的少年有些忌惮道。
“现在四下无人，过了这个村可就没这个店了。”叫龙哥的少年沉声道。
“那两个小妞的确是极品，但是她们一个是秦关的女人，一个是秦关的小姨子，若是被他知道一定会杀了我们的。”
消瘦的少年忌惮道。
叫龙哥的少年对着消瘦少年就是一巴掌：
“你个怂货，就你这样的一辈子尝不到好滋味，那秦关现在得罪了灵剑学院，等秘境结束不光他自身难保，整个南家都会彻底消失，咱们干完了这一票，及时退出秘境，片叶不沾身懂吗？”
闻言，消瘦少年有些迟疑：“那秘境我们不探索了吗？”
“蠢货，现在爬到一半都已经快吃不消了，你能到山顶？”
“说的也对啊！”消瘦少年眼神一亮，旋即又一脸猥琐道：“龙哥，两个小妞一人一个啊！”
“什么一人一个，用完了互换不更爽吗？”
“哈哈，还是龙哥会玩，想想都刺激啊！”
“踏马的小点声。”
两名少年商量一番后加快了上山速度。
不多时，二人来到了南柔与南乔身后。
叫龙哥的那名少年笑道：
“两位姑娘，上山还有将近一半的路程，越往上压力就会越大，若是不顾身体硬撑，经脉很容易会被压伤的。”
南柔与南乔闻言纷纷转头看向下方。
“多谢提醒。”发现是云岚宗的弟子，南乔冲二人拱手致意。
“修行不易，不如我们四人一起吧，路上也好有个照应。”叫龙哥的少年笑道。
“对对，一起爬山还不累！”消瘦少年急忙点头，脸上写满了不怀好意。
“玛德…”
content_en:
Soon Qinguan came to the foot of the mountain.
Stairs are like dragons, winding and extending to the top of the mountain.
Under the stairs, a wooden sign was inserted with four words written on it: Act within your ability.
Act within your ability.
Qinguan glanced at the wooden sign and stepped on the mountain ladder.
When Qin Guan stepped onto the first step of the mountain ladder, an invisible pressure arose spontaneously, as if he was carrying a big stone.
"It turns out to be the gravity field."
Qin Guan smiled lightly. This pressure was just an itch for him. After all, he used to carry a hill for squat training.
Qin Guan moved very quickly and disappeared around the first corner in a short while.
At the same time, everyone else was in the same space as Qinguan, except that the pressure on them going up the mountain was much less than that on Qinguan.
Half an hour later.
On a mountainside, Nan Qiao and Nan Rou were walking one behind the other. Every step they took seemed to be very difficult. Their faces were pale, and their bones were all painful from being pressed.
At this time, not far behind the two, two teenagers in blue clothes were sneaking around. They would look behind them from time to time.
"Brother Long, I think it's better to forget it." One of the thin young men said with some fear.
"There is no one around now, and there is no shop like this after passing this village." The young man named Long Ge said solemnly.
"Those two girls are indeed the best, but one of them is a woman from Qinguan, and the other is Qinguan's sister-in-law. If he finds out, he will definitely kill us."
The thin young man said fearfully.
The boy named Long Ge slapped the skinny boy:
"You coward, you are the only one who will never have a good taste in your life. Then Qinguan has offended the Spirit Sword Academy. When the secret realm ends, not only will he be able to save himself, but the entire Nan family will disappear completely. After we finish this job, we will exit the secret realm in time. Do you understand?"
Hearing this, the skinny young man hesitated: "Aren't we going to explore the secret realm?"
"Idiot, I'm halfway through the climb and it's almost too much. Can you get to the top?"
"That's right!" The skinny young man's eyes lit up, and then he said with a vulgar expression: "Brother Long, there are two chicks, one for each!"
"One for each person, wouldn't it be more fun to swap them when they're used up?"
"Haha, Brother Long still knows how to play, it's exciting just thinking about it!"
"The sound of a horse riding a horse."
The two teenagers speeded up the mountain after discussing it.
Not long after, the two came behind Nan Rou and Nan Qiao.
The young man named Brother Long smiled and said:
"You two girls, there is still nearly half the way up the mountain. The pressure will increase as you go up. If you don't care about your body and hold on, your meridians will easily be crushed."
After hearing this, Nan Rou and Nan Qiao turned their heads and looked down.
"Thanks for the reminder." When he discovered that he was a disciple of the Yunlan Sect, Nan Qiao rushed to greet the two of them.
"Practice is not easy, so why don't the four of us come together so we can have someone to look after us on the way." The young man named Brother Long said with a smile.
"That's right, it's not tiring to climb the mountain together!" The skinny boy nodded hurriedly, with ill intentions written on his face.
"Made..."
